technique_name: Design an algorithm to solve the Eight Queens puzzle
description: A potential algorithm for solving the Eight Queens puzzle is the backtracking algorithm. This algorithm uses a recursive approach to systematically check all possible solutions until a valid one is found. It begins by placing a Queen in the first row and then proceeds through each of the remaining rows, one by one.
